source_findings.detail: window_join.rs implements its own join; it does not call state_join.rs::run_join. Boundary Some(Coin) is consulted again on every spend while alive=false, permitting repeated resolution of a spent boundary coin. Known in-window repeated spends become Unresolved and excluded rather than a multiplicity violation.

window_join.rs has no nonzero exit on validation counters or script_failures. Zero workers are accepted, while verified_inputs is computed from admitted tasks rather than completed successful checks. It materializes every emitted event regardless of invalidity or exclusion.

449 blocks cannot be a contiguous 1448-height span. The builder uses BIP34 heights and latest-earlier occurrences, without selected-header-chain membership. Missing creation-ledger entries do not establish orphan/unspendable causes. Metadata and unspent-boundary status are not authenticated by a source txid recheck.

Fixture run_join omits scripts and UTXO-dependent sigop checks. window_join uses saturating fee aggregation without money_range aggregate check, incomplete coinbase sigops, and no contextual block validation or BIP68 evaluation. Height 340787..342234 is below local mainnet CSV/BIP113 activation at 419328.
